# Near Me

> Deposit-backed event registration you can add to any website. Guests put down a small refundable USDC deposit; people who show up get it back plus an equal share of the no-shows' deposits. Funds sit in a NEAR smart contract, never with the organizer or with us. No platform fee.

An event can instead sell a paid ticket (mode `Ticket`): one price per guest, held in the contract and paid to the host once the event has started; refunded if the host cancels. An event is either deposit or ticket, never both.

This file is for AI coding agents adding Near Me to a host's website. Everything loads from the Near Me host that serves this file; below it is written as `https://NEAR-ME-HOST` (use the origin you fetched this file from).

## Add the widget (any site)

1. Load the script once per page:
   `<script src="https://NEAR-ME-HOST/embed.js" async></script>`
2. Put the element next to the event, where guests would sign up:
   `<near-event event="EVENT_ID"></near-event>`

The site keeps its own event page; the element renders only a deposit box (amount, seats left) with a "Pay deposit · N USDC" button. The host sets the deposit up once at /widget (no event is created again on Near Me). Sign-up and payment open in a small window on the Near Me domain (wallets and Google sign-in need a first-party page). Never copy or modify embed.js; always load it from the host. The widget needs no API keys or secrets.

### Attributes
- `mode="button"`: only the button
- `label="…"`: button text
- `then="https://…"`: the site's existing registration form; guests pay the deposit first, then continue there. `{account}` and `{event}` in the URL are replaced (e.g. `?ref={account}`)
- `theme="light|dark|auto"`, `accent="#hex"`, `font="geist|poppins|system"`, `display="serif"`, `radius="12"`: match the site's design

### JavaScript
- `NearEvents.open(EVENT_ID, { then, accent, theme })` opens sign-up from the site's own button
- `window.addEventListener("near-events:registered", e => e.detail)` → `{ eventId, accountId }`
- The element also fires `registered` (bubbles, composed)

### No scripts allowed
`<iframe src="https://NEAR-ME-HOST/embed/e/EVENT_ID" title="Event registration" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;max-width:560px;height:260px;border:0"></iframe>`

### Just a link
`https://NEAR-ME-HOST/p/EVENT_ID` is the payment page (add `?then=` the same way). Use it in a Luma event description, Instagram bio, WhatsApp, email or a QR code at the venue.

## Where to paste, per platform
- Plain HTML / static: both lines into the page
- Next.js: `next/script` with `strategy="afterInteractive"`, render `<near-event>` in JSX; TypeScript: declare `"near-event"` in `React.JSX.IntrinsicElements`
- React (Vite): script tag in index.html, element in a component
- Vue / Nuxt: script in index.html or `app.head`; `compilerOptions.isCustomElement = (tag) => tag === "near-event"`
- Svelte / Astro: script in the root layout
- Angular: script in index.html, `CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA`
- WordPress: a "Custom HTML" block
- Webflow: an "Embed" element
- Tilda: an "HTML code" block (T123)
- Wix: "Embed code" → "Embed HTML"
- Squarespace: a "Code" block
- Framer: an "Embed" component (HTML)
- Luma, Google Forms, Typeform, Eventbrite: they don't run scripts; put the payment link `https://NEAR-ME-HOST/p/EVENT_ID?then=<the form or Luma URL>` in the description or first question

## Content-Security-Policy
If the site sets one, allow: `script-src`, `frame-src` and `connect-src` for `https://NEAR-ME-HOST`.

## Read-only API
`GET https://NEAR-ME-HOST/api/embed/EVENT_ID` → `{ id, title, starts_at, ends_at, location, status, deposit_usdc, mode, going, capacity, full }` (CORS open). `mode` is `Deposit` or `Ticket`; `deposit_usdc` is the price in both.

## For hosts
- Create and manage events from the Telegram bot: /new, deposit notifications, guest list, check-in, payouts and refunds (each confirmed by the host).

## Verify
Run the site, open the page, confirm the deposit box or button renders and that clicking Pay deposit opens the Near Me window. Report which files changed.
